# HyperFab (هایپرفب)

> HyperFab is a manufacturing company and online manufacturing platform in Tehran, Iran, run by an engineering team. Online, it offers FDM and resin 3D printing, CNC machining, metal and non-metal laser cutting and sheet metal bending, with an instant online price estimator (STL/3MF for 3D printing, DXF for laser cutting and bending), and "Tekeyab", a service for buying small, cut-to-size pieces of industrial material. For industrial and batch production, it offers sheet and tube punching (metal and polyethylene), mould making and plastic injection moulding, batch CNC turning (brass, MO40/42CrMo4, CK45/C45), aluminium extrusion with custom sections, TIG and MIG welding of stainless steel and 6000-series aluminium with welded fabrication and weld testing (VT, PT, PAUT), silver and gold plating, anodizing and chromate (Alodine), and powder coating. The main website, where online ordering happens, is https://hyperfab.ir (Persian); industrial projects are arranged by phone. This GitHub Pages site is HyperFab's official overview in Persian and English.

Key facts:
- Name: HyperFab; Persian: هایپرفب. Main website: https://hyperfab.ir
- Location: Unit 1, No. 39, corner of Tehrani Alley, Safi-Alishah St., Pich-e Shemiran, Enghelab St., Tehran, Iran
- Phone: +98 21 7752 7438; mobile, Bale and Telegram (also industrial projects): +98 996 223 3898; email: info@hyperfab.ir
- Hours: Saturday–Wednesday 09:00–17:00, Thursday 09:00–13:00 (Tehran time); online ordering 24/7
- Online services: 3D printing, CNC, laser and bending orders usually within 3 working days; minimum order one part; ships across Iran (Post, Tipax, Snappbox); free pickup in Tehran
- Instant online pricing: FDM 3D printing (STL, 3MF) and laser cutting / bending (DXF). Pricing runs in the customer's browser; the file is uploaded only when the order is placed. Resin printing and CNC machining are quoted after engineer review.
- Industrial and batch services: quoted per project after engineering review. Tooling-based services (punching, injection moulding, extrusion) are priced as a tooling cost plus a cost per stroke or shot, or by tonnage. Plating, anodizing, powder coating and CNC turning are for production runs; one-off parts are rarely accepted. Aluminium extrusion: the customer brings the required tonnage and pays for the die; HyperFab's engineering team handles section consultation, die, production and delivery.
- Track record: four polyethylene injection moulds taken from build to commissioning with 80,000+ parts produced; quality control of 8,000 punched tubes; kidney-shaped slots punched in 125 mm polyethylene pipe (5 mm wall, 6 bar); batch brass mating parts and MO40/CK45 gauge parts approved by customers; many stainless and aluminium welded units for the medical and marine industries; a large framed platform chassis on wheels running on rails; an AISI 304 stainless sealing assembly made end to end (CNC turning, TIG welding, PT tested); batch PTFE parts and gaskets for the chemical industry.
- Team: engineers including two Sharif University of Technology graduates in mechanical engineering (applied design) and a manufacturing engineering specialist.

- [Powder coating](https://hyperfab-ir.github.io/en/powder-coating/) ([Persian](https://hyperfab-ir.github.io/powder-coating/)): powder, pearl, hammer and textured finishes

## Services on the main website (hyperfab.ir)

- [Order a part / instant quote](https://hyperfab.ir/order/): upload a file, choose the process and get a price
- [3D printing — FDM and resin](https://hyperfab.ir/services/3d-printing/): PLA, PETG, ABS, TPU; 0.1–0.3 mm layers; resin at 16K resolution (about 14 × 19 µm XY), 0.02–0.1 mm layers
- [CNC machining](https://hyperfab.ir/services/cnc/): milling and turning of POM/PE, PTFE, PA6 nylon, PMMA, POM-C and brass; ±0.05 mm tolerance
- [Metal laser cutting](https://hyperfab.ir/services/laser-metal/): mild steel, stainless steel, aluminium, galvanised; fibre laser with nitrogen; ±0.1 mm; DXF with instant price
- [Non-metal laser cutting and engraving](https://hyperfab.ir/services/laser-nonmetal/): acrylic, MDF, wood, leather, felt, foam; CO2 laser; ±0.1 mm
- [Sheet metal bending](https://hyperfab.ir/services/bending/): press brake, V-die air bending, ±1°; combined with laser cutting
- [Tekeyab](https://hyperfab.ir/tekeyab/): sheet, bar, shaft, flat bar, tube and profile in aluminium, stainless steel, steel, copper, brass and engineering plastics; cut to size
